title: Shemirat Halashon 26

chapters.title: Introduction to Avak Lashon Hara
chapters.about: chapter 9 introduction, dust of lashon hara

chapters.title: Praising in Public
chapters.about: paragraph 2, public crowds, exceptions for respected figures

chapters.title: Praise Leading to Loss
chapters.about: guests, loans, avoiding negative consequences from compliments

chapters.title: Gossipers and Rebuffing
chapters.about: living near gossipers, obligation to rebuke, silence as agreement

chapters.title: Educating Children
chapters.about: chinuch, training children, generational habits of speech

summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through chapter nine of Shemirat HaLashon, discussing the concept of dust of lashon hara (avak lashon hara) and how indirect remarks or excessive praise can lead to negative speech. He also covers the laws regarding public praise, avoiding neighborhoods of gossipers, rebuking those who speak improperly, and the obligation to educate young children in proper speech.
questions: What is considered avak lashon hara?
When is it permitted to praise someone in public?
How should one handle praising a guest or someone who gave a loan to prevent causing them financial loss?
What is the obligation if you hear people speaking lashon hara in a group?
How does educating children properly relate to preventing lashon hara?
